items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You’ve got a tune dedicated to Lunceford. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, wow. Yeah.

ctx.x: B.B., yeah. I love his playing. I’d rather hear him play just maybe one or two notes than most guys play all night, ‘cause it means something. And then, and he’ll play and he can’t sort of play the guitar and sing at the same time or something. So then he’ll stop and… (laughs) But yeah, so that was… Obviously, that’s what Lead Belly… And then, I guess the Charlie Christian thing had to do with my habit. He was my spiritual awakening, (laughs) as I said, so…
You’ve got a tune dedicated to Lunceford.
